DEF-180.title: In-page vendor signals in OpenRTB envelopes lack format tagging and bid.ext preview
DEF-180.expected: The project-documented widget/zone and bid.ext in-page dialect can be identified as vendor in-page content even when carried in an OpenRTB envelope; bid.ext-only creative support is reported separately. Standard OpenRTB requires a media object, so imp.format_required for these bare widget impressions is correct and remains asserted.
DEF-180.actual: Format detection does not tag these imp/seatbid-shaped widget examples as inpage, and the preview does not render nested bid.ext cards. The adm-bearing control renders its markup correctly. The request media-object error is not an implementation deviation.
notes: This is a vendor capability distinction, not proof that media-free impressions comply with IAB OpenRTB. The earlier reading of conditional Imp field-table entries was incomplete; section 3.1 explicitly requires a media object.
Only missing vendor tagging and case-specific creative identity failures remain pinned. Response-dialect validation and baseline request rejection are asserted independently.

DEF-181.title: The clickurl feed alias, recognized by format-detect.js, is missing from detect.js's single-object classifier and rules-feed.js's push-material validator
DEF-181.expected: The product's own committed in-page card feed sample (manifest id kb-jsonfeed-inpage-001) uses `clickurl`, which packages/core/format-detect.js's hasClick set already recognizes as a click-key alias (alongside clickUrl/click_url/redirectUrl/link) for FORMATS.INPAGE tagging. The same alias should be recognized consistently everywhere else a click key is checked for this shape: detect.js's single-object payload-type classifier, rules-feed.js's push-materials click role (canonical click_url, alias link), and the front-end's findPushMaterial()/isMat() card-recognition heuristic.
DEF-181.actual: The exact reviewed deviations are pinned separately for each case and layer; successful or unrelated findings are not admitted as gaps.
notes: Normative assertions were authored from the product's own knowledge_base/jsonfeed/inpage/inpage-card.json sample and format-detect.js's hasClick set before execution. Known-gap signatures document observed failures only; they are not expected output snapshots.

Three symptoms of one alias-propagation gap (payload-type detection, push-material field validation, and front-end card recognition) are grouped under this one id, matching the established one-id-per-case convention.

inpage-x-card-feed-array additionally, unavoidably reproduces the pre-existing DEF-201 ('Inspector cannot select every returned bid or feed material') for its second card; that signature is folded into this case's own knownGap.matches.browser rather than declared as a second knownGap, and DEF-201 itself is left untouched in known-gaps.json since this case's declared id is DEF-181, not DEF-201.
